contact.name: Gestion Pédagogique
contact.designation: It consists of the Director, the Deputy Director, 5 teacher representatives, 3 union representatives, 2 representatives
contact.evidence_quote: The Pedagogical Management Council (Conseil de Gestion Pédagogique - CGP) ... It consists of the Director, the Deputy Director, 5 teacher representatives, 3 union representatives, 2 representatives of the assistants, 1 representative of the non-teaching staff and 5 student delegates. It is led by the Director. The teachers and the non-teaching staff representative are elected for a term of 4 years which may be renewed; the student reps are elected for 1 year, which may be renewed. The council meets once a month, more often at the beginning and end of the school year.
